<thought>Using the exact mass 134.10955 Da from the ESI‑MS spectrum, the formula that best matches this mass is C₅H₁₄N₂O₂ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 134.1055 Da, within typical instrument error). Therefore the molecular formula is C5H14O2N2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H14O2N2</final_answer>
